faqs.question: Do these tools cost anything?
faqs.answer: No. Every tool is free, and the code is open source under the MIT license.

faqs.question: Do I have to sign in?
faqs.answer: No. There are no accounts, no cookies and no analytics.

faqs.question: Do the results have a watermark?
faqs.answer: No. Nothing is added to your download. The watermark tool only adds the text you type.

faqs.question: Why does a tool pause the first time I run it?
faqs.answer: Video tools, OCR, the upscaler and speech-to-text download an engine or model from a public CDN on the first run. That download contains none of your data, and your file is then processed on your device.

faqs.question: Can I host my own copy?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is a static site: build it once and deploy it to GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel or any web server.

salary-calculator.description: Convert pay between hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly and yearly. Set your hours per week and paid weeks to match your job.

roman-numeral-converter.title: Free Roman Numeral Converter
roman-numeral-converter.metaTitle: Roman Numeral Converter: Numbers to Roman Numerals
roman-numeral-converter.description: Convert numbers from 1 to 3999 to Roman numerals and Roman numerals back to numbers. Non-standard forms such as IIII are flagged.

bmr-calculator.title: Free BMR Calculator
bmr-calculator.metaTitle: BMR Calculator: Basal Metabolic Rate (Mifflin-St Jeor)
bmr-calculator.description: Calculate your basal metabolic rate, the calories your body burns at rest, with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, plus daily needs for each activity level.

hourly-to-salary-calculator.title: Free Hourly to Salary Calculator
hourly-to-salary-calculator.metaTitle: Hourly to Salary Calculator: Wage to Annual Pay
hourly-to-salary-calculator.description: Turn an hourly wage into yearly, monthly, biweekly, weekly and daily pay. Change hours per week and paid weeks for part-time or seasonal work.

color-palette-generator.title: Free Color Palette Generator
color-palette-generator.metaTitle: Color Palette Generator: From Image or One Color
color-palette-generator.description: Extract a color palette from any image, or build analogous, complementary, triadic and shade palettes from one color. Copy HEX codes or CSS variables.

color-converter.title: Free Color Converter
color-converter.metaTitle: Color Converter: HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK
color-converter.description: Convert any color between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK, with a picker and a WCAG contrast check against white and black text.

hex-to-rgb.title: Free HEX to RGB Converter
hex-to-rgb.description: Convert HEX color codes to RGB instantly, including 3-digit and 8-digit codes with alpha. HSL, HSV and CMYK are shown too.

rgb-to-hex.title: Free RGB to HEX Converter
rgb-to-hex.description: Convert RGB values to a HEX color code instantly. Paste rgb(), rgba() or three numbers, and copy the hex code or any other format.

favicon-generator.title: Free Favicon Generator
favicon-generator.metaTitle: Favicon Generator: ICO, PNG and Apple Touch Icon
favicon-generator.description: Create a complete favicon package from a logo, letter or emoji: favicon.ico, PNGs from 16 to 512 px, an Apple touch icon, a web manifest and the HTML tags.

image-to-base64.title: Free Image to Base64 Converter
image-to-base64.metaTitle: Image to Base64 Converter: Data URI for HTML and CSS
image-to-base64.description: Convert an image to Base64 and get a data URI, raw Base64, a CSS background rule or an HTML img tag. Works with PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP and GIF.

svg-optimizer.title: Free SVG Optimizer
svg-optimizer.metaTitle: SVG Optimizer Online: Minify and Clean SVG Files
svg-optimizer.description: Make SVG files smaller by removing comments, metadata, editor data from Illustrator, Inkscape, Sketch and Figma, scripts and long decimals. Preview and compare sizes.

meme-generator.title: Free Meme Generator
meme-generator.metaTitle: Meme Generator: Add Top and Bottom Text to Images
meme-generator.description: Make a meme from your own picture with classic top and bottom text in bold outlined letters. Adjust size and color, then download a PNG.

tic-tac-toe.title: Free Tic Tac Toe
tic-tac-toe.metaTitle: Tic Tac Toe Online: Play vs Computer or a Friend
tic-tac-toe.description: Play tic tac toe in your browser against an unbeatable computer, an easy one, or a friend on the same screen. No download and no account.

memory-game.title: Free Memory Game
memory-game.metaTitle: Memory Game Online: Match the Pairs
memory-game.description: Flip cards and find matching pairs in this classic memory game. Choose 6, 8 or 12 pairs and try to finish in as few moves as possible.

reaction-time-test.title: Free Reaction Time Test
reaction-time-test.metaTitle: Reaction Time Test: Measure Your Reflexes in ms
reaction-time-test.description: Test your reaction time in milliseconds: wait for green, then click or press Space. See your average, median and best over the last five tries.

color-blind-test.title: Free Color Blind Test
color-blind-test.metaTitle: Color Blind Test Online: Quick Ishihara-Style Check
color-blind-test.description: Take a quick color vision screening with eight Ishihara-style dot plates drawn in your browser. Type the number you see and get a simple result.

gamepad-tester.title: Free Gamepad Tester
gamepad-tester.metaTitle: Gamepad Tester: Check Controller Buttons and Stick Drift
gamepad-tester.description: Test an Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro or other controller in your browser. See every button, trigger pressure and stick position live, and spot stick drift.

what-is-my-ip.title: Free What Is My IP
what-is-my-ip.metaTitle: What Is My IP Address? Check Your Public IP
what-is-my-ip.description: See your public IP address the way websites see it, with IPv4 or IPv6 and the country your network reports. One click, no tracking.

internet-speed-test.title: Free Internet Speed Test
internet-speed-test.metaTitle: Internet Speed Test: Download, Upload and Ping
internet-speed-test.description: Test your internet speed: download, upload, latency and jitter, plus latency under load, measured against Cloudflare's global network. Starts only when you press the button.

dns-lookup.title: Free DNS Lookup
dns-lookup.metaTitle: DNS Lookup: Check A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS Records
dns-lookup.description: Look up DNS records for any domain: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA, with TTLs. Queries go over HTTPS to Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1 resolver.

currency-converter.title: Free Currency Converter
currency-converter.description: Convert between 30+ currencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and CNY, with daily mid-market reference rates from central banks via the Frankfurter API.

services.currency-converter: the Frankfurter API (api.frankfurter.dev, European Central Bank reference rates)
